working_products.english_description: Indulge in our delicious Fudgy Milky Bar! Featuring a rich, dense, and ultra-fudgy texture that melts in your mouth, this treat boasts a luscious flavor reminiscent of a classic caramel bar. Topped with crunchy nuts for the perfect contrast, it's an irresistible sweet snack that pairs wonderfully with your favorite coffee or tea.
working_products.allergens_source_text: Contains Wheat, Dairy (Milk/Butter), Eggs, and Nuts.

working_products.english_description: Indulge in our signature Cheezy Ensaymada! A beloved Filipino pastry favorite, this soft and fluffy bun is generously topped with rich butter, sweet sugar crystals, and a mountain of savory grated cheese. The irresistible combination of sweet and salty flavors makes it the perfect treat to enjoy with your favorite coffee or tea.
